source.description:
## PROBLEM
Packed 3.21.6 live tracked service-knowledge-sync jobs finish with terminal event: `Failed after 5 attempts (appendEvent): UNIQUE constraint failed: specialist_forensic_events.job_id, specialist_forensic_events.seq/gitnexus_analyze_start_failed`. Reproduced on independent infra and market-data jobs in isolated XDG databases. The model result may still be produced, but the GitNexus analyze event is lost and telemetry reports a misleading terminal failure.

## EVIDENCE
Jobs d5dc3c and efc5ae under unitAI-jndsb.13 receipt evidence; both show same collision. Infra also left GitNexus skill-layout changes in its isolated worktree while reporting clean.

## SUCCESS
Reserve/serialize forensic sequence allocation transactionally for GitNexus analyzer lifecycle events; no retries end in UNIQUE failure; terminal status accurately distinguishes analysis failure, telemetry persistence failure, and agent success. Add concurrent append regression and inspect audit-mode side effects.
source.title: gitnexus analyze terminal event collides with forensic sequence
